name: BN6's Request BBS
now: Mapped from bn6f's reqBBS.s and driven in a run: the BBS's record (0x0814112C: its RAM archives, flag bases 0x1B60 posted, 0x1BA0 unread, 0x1BE0 taken, 0x1C20 finished, 0x1C60 done, the list 0x02000290 and its count 0x020065B0), its two LZ77 archives' words at 0x08141158 (titles, posts), its own lines at 0x087EED68 and its accept (0x173A one at a time, 0x1BE0 + request taken). A run posts its three requests as BN6's 0-2 with its own archives (literal-only LZ77 in free space); BN6's screen lists them, reads a post, asks Take this request? and its taken flag became the asker's Yes in a headless run.
left: The BBS's rank and points (requests 0-2 need rank C) left as BN6 keeps them; the done flag (0x1C60) unused: a run's asker settles in person.
